title: The Effect of the Association EGCG, Folic Acid and Vitamin B12 in Preventing the Persistence of HPV Infection.
official: A Pilot Study to Test the Effect of the Association of Epigallocatechin Gallate (EGCG), Folic Acid and Vitamin B12 in Preventing the Persistence of Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) Infection.
summary: The purpose of the study is to test the effect of the administration of a dietary supplement consisting of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), vitamin B12 and folic acid in the treatment of infections with papilloma virus of the cervix.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HR-HPV DNA test positivity

Exclusion Criteria:

* No HSIL
